lines.text: Many learners say: I read it in the internet.
Better: I read it on the internet.
On! I saw it on the internet.

data.wrong: I read it in the internet.
data.right: I read it on the internet.

native.tip: В интернете — “on the internet”: “I read it on the internet.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I read it in the internet”? 😅 По-русски «в интернете» — с «в», и хочется сказать “in”, но по-английски верно “on.” Правильно: “I read it on the internet.” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.

en.tip: For the internet, use “on”: “I read it on the internet.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I read it in the internet”? 😅 In Russian «в» leads to “in”, but English says “on.” Correct: “I read it on the internet.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
